description: Choose what to scrape on Allegro.pl: keyword searches, category pages, seller storefronts, offer or product URLs, product reviews, or seller profiles.

buyNowOnly.description: Exclude auctions and keep only offers you can buy immediately.
buyNowOnly.title: Buy Now Only

categoryUrls.description: Allegro category URLs, or category ids/aliases. (mode=byCategory)
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

freeShippingOnly.description: Use Allegro's free-delivery (Smart!) filter for listing modes.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free Delivery Only

includeDetails.description: Open each offer from search, category, seller and product-offer listings to add stock, GTIN, full specs, company identity, warranty and returns. Slower and uses more requests.
includeDetails.title: Enrich With Offer Details

includeSponsored.description: Include sponsored placements in listing results. Turn off for organic results only.
includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Offers

market.description: Allegro marketplace. Only Poland (allegro.pl) is supported.
market.title: Market

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Listing modes cap each source at 6,000 offers (100 pages).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Highest price in PLN. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum reviews to collect for each product in reviews mode.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max Reviews Per Product

minPrice.description: Lowest price in PLN. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

mode.description: What to scrape. Search by keyword, browse categories or sellers, fetch specific offer/product URLs, get every seller for a product, read product reviews, or build seller profiles.
mode.title: Mode

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search for. One query per line. (mode=search)
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sortBy.description: Order of results for search, category, seller and product-offer listings.
enumTitles: Price with delivery: low to high
Price with delivery: high to low
sortBy.title: Sort By

startUrls.description: Offer, product, product-offers, seller or review target URLs. Use this for byUrl, bySeller, byProduct, reviews and sellerProfiles.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

superSellerOnly.description: Keep only offers from Allegro Super Sellers.
superSellerOnly.title: Super Seller Only

title: Allegro Scraper Input
